sources.title: GitHub - michsethowusu/kasanoma: Offline-first TTS models for African ...
sources.snippet: Kasanoma is an open-source initiative dedicated to building and sharing offline Text-to-Speech (TTS) models for languages of Africa. With Kasanoma models, you can generate natural-sounding voices entirely on your local device — no internet connection required. All models in this project are built using Piper, a fast, lightweight neural TTS system that runs efficiently on laptops, desktops ...
